item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 20/Oct/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A replenishment of the northeast monsoon is expected to reach the coast of southern China later today, bringing rainy weather to the region. It will be windier over the coast of Guangdong during the weekend and slightly cooler in the morning and at night. With the strengthening of the anticyclone aloft, the weather will be mainly fine over the coast of southern China early to midweek next week. The temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Sanba will linger over the vicinity of Beibu Wan today and tomorrow, then weaken gradually.
